intro: Unending Torment is an Undercity quest involving the reanimation of the severed head of Grand Marshal Othmar Garithos. The Forsaken seek to interrogate their former Alliance foe by preparing a stitched abomination to serve as his new vessel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the Alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.
Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.
Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The abomination remains lifeless without a head to control it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The body twitches to life, panicking as it relives its final moments.
